meta.title: Drift Pic — Share photos with a random stranger
meta.description: Put your photo in a bottle, cast it to sea. Receive a bottle from someone, somewhere.

home.tagline: Send a photo to a stranger.
home.sub:
Put your photo in a bottle and cast it to sea.
A photo from somewhere in the world will drift back to you.
home.cta: Put a photo in a bottle
home.how1: Pick a photo and seal the bottle
home.how3: Wait for a bottle to drift back
home.note: Photos are automatically deleted 24 hours after exchange. No login. Fully anonymous.

send.title: Seal your photo in a bottle
send.dropHere: Drop your photo here, or click to select
send.rules: ※ Do not upload personal information or inappropriate content. You are solely responsible for your uploaded images. Images you send may be freely shared by the recipient using the share feature.

waiting.title: Your bottle is drifting...
waiting.message: Waiting for someone's bottle to arrive…
waiting.sub:
When another user casts their bottle, it will drift to you.
Keep this page open.
waiting.search1: Your bottle is adrift on the sea…
waiting.floating: Your bottle is drifting on the sea…
waiting.floatingSub: We'll let you know when someone finds it. Check back anytime.
